description: Cantidad diaria de residuos sólidos urbanos dispuestos en el relleno sanitario (en toneladas). Montevideo is a dataset listed in Uruguayan national open data catalogue (catalogodatos.gub.uy), an open data portal, published or maintained by MIDES. Masa total de residuos sólidos urbanos/domiciliarios dispuestos adecuadamente en Relleno Sanitario en el departamento de Montevideo. Coverage: Uruguay. The portal files it under the publisher MIDES. Its tags are Medio ambiente, Suelo. It offers 4 resource(s) in CSV, JSON, XLSX, XML. The portal shows 2020-07-31 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licencia de DAG de Uruguay. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-uy-portal.
